RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Spin To Win
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack grants spinning abilities 19.5% damage and 19.5% ability haste; Thousand Blades gains 32.5% damage. Teaches Ringblade Rush. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Dashing
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack grants movement abilities 113.75% ability haste. Teaches Blink. Walking does not count; cooldowns remain at least 1 second. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Outlaw’s Grit
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: A successful movement ability grants a defensive stack for 8 seconds, up to 5. Each card stack adds 9.75% defense per defensive stack. Teaches Blink. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Tooth Fairy
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Deal 25% of an eligible enemy core part's maximum health as actual damage within 2.5 seconds to drop a piercing fragment, once per target every 4 seconds. Collect within 2 cells for 0.65 permanent growth per card stack; fractions accumulate into whole stacks. Each whole stack adds 1 percentage point of penetration, capped at 200 points. Fragments last about 42 seconds.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Ethereal Weapon
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: The first effective ability hit on each target per cast triggers owned burn, health-based damage, bounded chains and lifesteal at 65% of their usual strength. Does not repeat an entire attack. Teaches Pursuit Mark.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Earthwake
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: After a movement ability, its straight path erupts after 0.75 seconds, dealing 11.7 secondary damage per stack to up to 16 visible enemies within 2 cells of the path. Teaches Blink. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Shadow Runner
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: After a movement ability, gain 48% movement speed per stack for 4 seconds. Teaches Blink. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Swift and Safe
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: After a movement ability, gain a 20-point shield per stack for 4 seconds. Refreshes to the stronger shield value. Teaches Blink. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Flashbang
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Enemies within 3.5 cells of your movement destination take 9.1 secondary damage per stack and are slowed for 5 seconds. Teaches Blink. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Trailblazer
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: After a movement ability, burn enemies within 3.5 cells of the destination. Each card stack adds 1.95 base damage per pulse. Does not ignite buildings. Teaches Blink. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Mystic Punch
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Effective direct attacks refund 0.65 second of card-granted basic ability cooldown per stack, at most once every 0.25 seconds. Does not refund path ultimates or relic cooldowns. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Critical Missile
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: A direct attack or ability critical hit fires a bonus missile for (7.8 + 1.95 × target health scale) damage per stack, at most once every 0.25 seconds. Missiles cannot generate more copies of themselves. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Critical Rhythm
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Direct attack critical hits grant rhythm stacks, up to 20, expiring after 10 seconds without another trigger. Each card stack adds 7.8% attack haste per rhythm stack. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Crit ’n Cast
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack grants ability haste equal to 65% of your critical value. Critical value is not consumed.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Soul Siphon
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Direct attack and ability critical hits heal ordinary injuries for 13% of actual damage per stack. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Erosion
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Direct and ability hits accumulate 0.65 erosion per card stack. Whole stacks are applied to the struck target, capped at 10 for 10 seconds; fractional progress is retained by the attacker. Each stack grants 4 percentage points of armor penetration. Armor-ignoring damage gains no benefit.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Thread the Needle
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Direct attacks and armor-checked abilities gain 13 percentage points of armor penetration per stack. Armor-ignoring secondary damage is unaffected. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: En Passant
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Hit the marked flank within 3 cells to deal 6.5 × target health scale bonus damage per stack, heal 6.5 injury points and gain 22.75% movement speed for 3 seconds. Each target can trigger once per 4 seconds. Teaches Pursuit Mark; selecting the owner shows enemy flanks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Quick Step
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Teaches Ringblade Rush: move, then strike in a circle. Each stack expands its radius by 0.4 cells, up to 2 extra cells. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Now You See Me
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Teaches Blink and Return. Within 3.25 seconds of moving, manually return to the previous origin within 12 visible cells on the same map. Returning does not create another origin.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Numb to Pain
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: After armor and shields, defer 22.75% of ordinary injury per stack over the next 5 seconds, up to 75%. Deferred injury does not receive another defense or shield reduction; healing can buy time to survive. Draft limit: 3 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Rejuvenation
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Successfully casting a combat ability heals 6 ordinary injury points per stack. Return, economic abilities and passive secondary damage do not trigger it. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Executioner
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Direct attacks and abilities deal 32.5% extra damage per stack to enemies at 40% health or lower. Eligible kills refund 1.95 seconds of card-granted basic ability cooldown per stack. Does not instantly execute bosses. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Infinite Recursion
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each eligible kill grants 0.65 permanent growth per card stack. Ability haste equals 10% of the square root of accumulated growth. Repeatedly resurrected enemies count only once.
